description: This file defines a Java interface for the RunReportsApi service in the Apache Fineract client. It contains method signatures for executing reports via HTTP GET requests, returning either report data or files, with detailed documentation on report usage and parameters.

classes.name: RunReportsApi
classes.description: Java interface defining methods for executing reports through Fineract's reporting API, including retrieving report data and files.

methods.name: runReportGetData
methods.description: Fetches report data from the server as a structured response, using report name and dynamic parameters.

methods.name: runReportGetFile
methods.description: Retrieves a report as a file (PDF, CSV, XLS, etc.) by report name and dynamic parameters, returning the raw HTTP response.
